no_delivery_store.statement: There is no delivery-level dedup store: no webhook_events table, no unique index on event_id. The event id is written to the log and nowhere else, so whether a replay ever happened cannot be checked afterwards.

guards.path: One-time enrolment payment (payment_created with an enrolment reference)
guards.key: Enrolment payment_status: if already 'paid', return the enrolment unchanged
guards.covers: A repeated notice does not mark the enrolment paid twice or count the seat twice

guards.path: Subscription checkout (payment_created with a SUB- reference)
guards.key: Subscription status: if already 'active', return it unchanged
guards.covers: A repeated notice does not activate the subscription twice

guards.path: Recurring (scheduled) charge (payment_created with no reference, matched by schedule)
guards.key: Payment id: skip if it equals the payment id last applied to the subscription. Deliberately not status, which would make every renewal a no-op.
guards.covers: An immediate repeat of the latest scheduled payment does not advance the period twice

guards.path: Reconciliation sweep linking a missed payment (not a notice, but it grants the same seat)
guards.key: Re-reads the enrolment; if already 'paid', does nothing
guards.covers: A sweep after a notice already applied does not count the seat again

also_checked.key: Marks past due only WHERE status = 'active'

also_checked.path: One-time payment returned (payment_returned with an enrolment reference)
also_checked.key: No handler: only payment_failed is acted on

uncovered.shape: A replay of an older scheduled payment (not the latest one)
uncovered.effect: Its payment id differs from the last one stored, so the billing period advances again: a member gets a period they did not pay for.
uncovered.why: G3 compares only with the last applied payment id (subscriptionScheduleService.ts:224).

uncovered.shape: A repeat of a one-time enrolment payment notice
uncovered.effect: The seat is safe, but the welcome email is sent again (when automatic email is on) and the class-readiness campaign sign-up runs again.
uncovered.why: G1 returns the already-paid enrolment, and the handler runs the follow-on steps whenever an enrolment comes back (webhookController.ts:147, :162; automationService.ts:49-60 has no dedup).

uncovered.shape: Two copies of the same notice arriving at the same moment
uncovered.effect: Both can pass the 'already paid / already active / same payment id' check before either saves, so a seat can be counted twice and emails sent twice.
uncovered.why: Each guard is read-then-write with no row lock or unique key (enrollmentService.ts:111-117; paymentReconciliationService.ts:209-210).

uncovered.shape: A stale failure notice replayed after the member has recovered
uncovered.effect: A member who has since paid and is active is marked past due again.
uncovered.why: The past-due update checks only that the row is active, not which payment failed (subscriptionScheduleService.ts:263-266).

uncovered.effect: Cannot be detected after the fact.
uncovered.why: No delivery-level record exists; the event id is only logged (webhookController.ts:56-58).
